name: relu
doc:
ReLU：`max x 0`。

⚠ **平行定义提示（v14，S9 重复实现审计发现；coordinator 已核实）**：
本文件 **62 个传递 importer**（**全库 14.8%**），是**最高爆炸半径**的定义之一。
全库另有**同名 `relu`** 出现在 `RealExtractInvertibility`（及 `RealNonlinearFidelity` 相关链）；
`Lattice.sigmoid` 在 `RealSwiGLU:23` 与 `RealExtractInvertibility:122` **各定义一次**，
`Lattice.geluTanh` 在 `RealActClass:74` 与 `RealExtractInvertibility:148` **各定义一次**。

- **合一物理不可行**：同时 `import` 两者会**报 `environment already contains 'Lattice.sigmoid'`**
  （`RealNonlinearFidelity.lean:25` **逐字记录了该真实报错**）；
- ⇒ **处置：不合一**（与"同一概念但不同名"的孪生对不同——那些是可以安全收敛的）；
  **仅在**声明端**加本标注**，因为**原先的登记只写在消费端**（`RealNonlinearFidelity.lean:28-36`），
  而**声明端**（本文件、`RealSwiGLU:23`、`RealActClass:74`）**零标注**。
- ⚠ **为何声明端也必须标注**：`CORRECTIONS.md:874-876` 已确立先例 ——
  **"不标注就会被下一轮扫描当活缺陷重报"**；扫描器读的是**声明处**，不是消费处。
- **⇒ 一般纪律：重复定义的登记应写在**声明端**（那里是扫描器与被引用者的交汇点）。**

name: relu_nonneg
proof:
by
  unfold relu
  exact le_max_right x 0

name: relu_eq_zero_iff
stmt: lemma relu_eq_zero_iff (x : ℝ) : relu x = 0 ↔ x ≤ 0
proof:
by
  unfold relu
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hnot
    have hpos : 0 < x := lt_of_not_ge hnot
    have hmax : max x 0 = x := max_eq_left (le_of_lt hpos)
    have : x = 0 := by simpa [hmax] using h
    linarith
  · intro h
    exact max_eq_right h

name: relu_preserves
stmt: theorem relu_preserves (x a : ℝ) : LeConstrR x a ↔ ReluOut x a = 0
proof:
by
  unfold LeConstrR ReluOut
  rw [relu_eq_zero_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h
    linarith
  · intro h
    linarith

name: sign_preserves
stmt: theorem sign_preserves (x a : ℝ) : x = a ↔ Real.sign (x - a) = 0
proof:
by
  rw [Real.sign_eq_zero_iff]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith

name: sumRelu_nonneg
stmt: lemma sumRelu_nonneg (xs : List (ℝ × ℝ)) : 0 ≤ SumRelu xs
proof:
by
  unfold SumRelu
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons h t ih =>
      have : 0 ≤ relu (h.1 - h.2) := relu_nonneg _
      change 0 ≤ relu (h.1 - h.2) +
        (t.map (fun q => relu (q.1 - q.2))).foldr (fun a b => a + b) 0
      nlinarith

name: sumRelu_eq_zero_iff_each
stmt:
lemma sumRelu_eq_zero_iff_each (xs : List (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    SumRelu xs = 0 ↔ ∀ p ∈ xs, ReluOut p.1 p.2 = 0
proof:
by
  unfold SumRelu
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons h t ih =>
      constructor
      · intro hsum p hp
        simp at hp
        rcases hp with rfl | ht
        ·                                         
          have hsum' : relu (p.1 - p.2) +
              (t.map (fun q => relu (q.1 - q.2))).foldr (fun a b => a + b) 0 = 0 := by
            simpa using hsum
          have hrestNonneg : 0 ≤
              (t.map (fun q => relu (q.1 - q.2))).foldr (fun a b => a + b) 0 := by
            simpa [SumRelu] using sumRelu_nonneg t
          have hh : relu (p.1 - p.2) = 0 := by
            nlinarith [relu_nonneg (p.1 - p.2), hrestNonneg]
          exact hh
        ·                     
          have hsum' : relu (h.1 - h.2) +
              (t.map (fun q => relu (q.1 - q.2))).foldr (fun a b => a + b) 0 = 0 := by
            simpa using hsum
          have hrestNonneg : 0 ≤
              (t.map (fun q => relu (q.1 - q.2))).foldr (fun a b => a + b) 0 := by
            simpa [SumRelu] using sumRelu_nonneg t
          have hrest : (t.map (fun q => relu (q.1 - q.2))).foldr (fun a b => a + b) 0 = 0 := by
            nlinarith [relu_nonneg (h.1 - h.2), hrestNonneg]

name: sumRelu_all_constraints
stmt:
theorem sumRelu_all_constraints (xs : List (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    (∀ p ∈ xs, LeConstrR p.1 p.2) ↔ SumRelu xs = 0
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hout : ∀ p ∈ xs, ReluOut p.1 p.2 = 0 := fun p hp => (relu_preserves p.1 p.2).mp (h p hp)
    exact (sumRelu_eq_zero_iff_each xs).mpr hout
  · intro h p hp
    exact (relu_preserves p.1 p.2).mpr ((sumRelu_eq_zero_iff_each xs).mp h p hp)

name: sumRelu_pos_of_unsatisfied
stmt:
theorem sumRelu_pos_of_unsatisfied (xs : List (ℝ × ℝ)) (p : ℝ × ℝ) (hp : p ∈ xs)
    (h : ¬ LeConstrR p.1 p.2) : 0 < SumRelu xs
proof:
by
  have hout : ReluOut p.1 p.2 ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    exact h ((relu_preserves p.1 p.2).mpr hz)
                      
  have hpos : 0 < relu (p.1 - p.2) := lt_of_le_of_ne (relu_nonneg (p.1 - p.2)) (by intro hz; exact hout (by simpa [ReluOut, hz]))
            
  have hle : relu (p.1 - p.2) ≤ SumRelu xs := by
    unfold SumRelu
                             
    induction xs with
    | nil => simp at hp
    | cons h2 t ih =>
        simp at hp
        rcases hp with rfl | ht
        ·                                             
          have hrest : 0 ≤ (t.map (fun q => relu (q.1 - q.2))).foldr (fun a b => a + b) 0 := by
            exact sumRelu_nonneg t
          change relu (p.1 - p.2) ≤
            relu (p.1 - p.2) + (t.map (fun q => relu (q.1 - q.2))).foldr (fun a b => a + b) 0
          nlinarith
        ·                     
          have : relu (p.1 - p.2) ≤ (t.map (fun q => relu (q.1 - q.2))).foldr (fun a b => a + b) 0 := ih ht
          have h2nonneg : 0 ≤ relu (h2.1 - h2.2) := relu_nonneg _
          change relu (p.1 - p.2) ≤
            relu (h2.1 - h2.2) + (t.map (fun q => relu (q.1 - q.2))).foldr (fun a b => a + b) 0
          nlinarith
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le hpos hle

end Lattice

name: markov_bound
proof:
by
                         
  have hm := mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg hf_nonneg hf_int ε
                                   
  have hm' : (μ { x | ε ≤ f x }).toReal ≤ (∫ x, f x ∂μ) / ε :=
    (le_div_iff₀ hε).mpr (by simpa [mul_comm] using hm)
  simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, one_div, mul_comm] using hm'

name: chebyshev_bound
proof:
by
                                                    
  have hset : { x | δ ≤ |X x - c| } = { x | δ ^ 2 ≤ (X x - c) ^ 2 } := by
    apply Set.ext
    intro x
    constructor
    · intro h
                                        
      have habs : |δ| ≤ |X x - c| := by simpa [abs_of_pos hδ] using h
      have hsq : δ ^ 2 ≤ |X x - c| ^ 2 := by
        rw [sq_abs]
        exact sq_le_sq.mpr habs
      simpa [sq_abs] using hsq
    · intro h
                                                      
      have habs : |δ| ≤ |X x - c| := (sq_le_sq.mp (by simpa [sq_abs] using h))
      simpa [abs_of_pos hδ, abs_of_nonneg (abs_nonneg _)] using habs
  rw [hset]
                             
  have hg_nonneg : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] fun x => (X x - c) ^ 2 := by
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => sq_nonneg _)
  have hm := mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg hg_nonneg hX_sq (δ ^ 2)
  have hδ2 : 0 < δ ^ 2 := pow_pos hδ 2
  have hm' : (μ { x | δ ^ 2 ≤ (X x - c) ^ 2 }).toReal ≤ (∫ x, (X x - c) ^ 2 ∂μ) / (δ ^ 2) :=
    (le_div_iff₀ hδ2).mpr (by simpa [mul_comm] using hm)
  simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, one_div, mul_comm] using hm'

name: verify_probability_guarantee
stmt:
theorem verify_probability_guarantee {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {μ : Measure α} {f : α → ℝ}
    (hf_nonneg : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] f) (hf_int : Integrable f μ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hE : ∫ x, f x ∂μ ≤ ε ^ 2) :
    (μ { x | ε ≤ f x }).toReal ≤ ε
proof:
by
                                    
  calc
    (μ { x | ε ≤ f x }).toReal ≤ (1 / ε) * ∫ x, f x ∂μ := markov_bound hf_nonneg hf_int hε
    _ ≤ (1 / ε) * ε ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hE (le_of_lt (one_div_pos.mpr hε))
    _ = ε := by
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hε]
      ring

                    
                                   
                                 
                                                     
                                       
                        

end Lattice
